tickets.test_detail: Access denied when trying to view purchase order request
tickets.description: User receives an access denied error when attempting to open a purchase order workflow request in PM7. The error appears immediately after clicking the request link.

tickets.test_detail: Request page times out after 30 seconds — no error code displayed
tickets.description: User reports that the workflow request page in System A consistently times out after approximately 30 seconds. No authorization or access error is shown. The timeout occurs regardless of request type.

tickets.summary: Slow page load when opening request
tickets.test: Request page takes over 60 seconds to load
tickets.test_detail: Page load time exceeds 60 seconds — no error message, no authorization issue
tickets.description: User reports extremely slow page load times when opening workflow requests in PM7. Pages take over 60 seconds to load. There is no error message or access denied indicator — the page eventually loads but is unusably slow.

tickets.summary: Cannot open workflow request — access denied
tickets.description: User received an access denied error when opening a System A workflow request. User subsequently completed the access management process and obtained the required roles. Issue resolved.

tickets.summary: Not authorized to view request — production impact
tickets.test_detail: You are not authorized to view this request.
tickets.description: Critical production user is unable to view a high-priority workflow request in PM7. The authorization error is blocking an urgent approval process. Escalated due to production impact.

tickets.test: User session terminates within seconds of login
tickets.test_detail: Session token invalidated immediately — error code SYNTH-SESSION-ERR-001
tickets.description: User reports that their session in System B is immediately invalidated after logging in. The user is redirected to the login page within a few seconds of successful authentication. No access denied message is shown.

tickets.test_detail: Access denied — you are not authorized to view this request.
tickets.description: User is unable to open a workflow request in System A and receives an authorization failure message. The issue is consistent across multiple requests in the system.

tickets.summary: Unknown error code when opening request
tickets.test_detail: Unhandled exception — error code SYNTH-ERR-999. No authorization message.
tickets.description: User encounters an unexpected error with code SYNTH-ERR-999 when trying to open a request form in PM7. The error is not an authorization or access denied message — it appears to be an unhandled application exception.

tickets.summary: Access denied on request page load
tickets.test_detail: Access denied when loading request page
tickets.description: User is blocked from accessing a System B workflow request. The access denied error appears immediately when the request page loads. User has confirmed this affects multiple requests in the system.
